verdict.rationale: Proa renders server-side on Axum and documents both in-order HTML flushing and out-of-order streaming of ready chunks through Suspense boundaries, so slow data does not block the page. Interactivity comes from hydrated islands that ship a small vanilla-JS module plus seed state on a runtime of about 1.3 KB gzipped, and GitHub confirms the server-rendered HTML plus island JS. Missing for 10: in-depth streaming documentation beyond homepage one-liners (e.g., API details, examples), and independent or hands-on corroboration that streaming works as claimed.
